text: Motor Vehicles * PAN must be quoted only if the purchase price of a vehicle (including high-end motorcycles) exceeds 5 lakh. Property Deals ¢ Forimmovable property transactions (sale, purchase, gifts, joint development agreements etc.), PAN quoting is mandatory only if the value exceeds %20 lakh. Hotels & Events * Payments to hotels, restaurants, convention centres, banquet halls or event managers require PAN only if each payment exceeds %1 lakh. Insurance Transactions * PAN must be provided at the start of an account-based relationship with an insurer, even if premiums do not immediately exceed a specific amount. This is a change from the earlier rule where PAN was required only when annual life insurance premiums crossed %50,000.
